name: CWI Attitude Engine
description: Turns a machine-readable Attitude Profile (identity + personality + attitude + behavior + capability, under mandatory bounds) into a Behavior Card: behavior_config JSON, a system-prompt-grade instruction block, and non-overridable bounds. Pure function, zero dependencies, deterministic.
limits: The engine emits behavioral configuration only; it grants no rights and makes no licensing commitments.
Capabilities never expand bounds.permissions; human_approval_triggers always route to a human.
provenance_policy: Profile claims carry provenance: verified | editorial | assumed. Sonic descriptors are editorial, never audio analysis.
